assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. EDIT TARGET image 1: this exact medieval granary B. Create complete building with ONLY roof changed, preserving entire original canvas and precise geometry. Add NATURAL IRREGULAR PILED SNOW covering about 70 percent of visible roof. Snow must form three or four large connected thick organic drifts with uneven soft contours and rounded overhanging edges, smoothly burying tile joints. Snow extends across many tiles as continuous masses. The surface of snow MUST NOT copy the tile grid, no individual white tiles, no white checkerboard, no evenly outlined tiles, no repeated little pillows. Leave broad irregular areas of brown clay tiles peeping through between snow drifts, roughly one quarter of roof. Subtle pale blue snow shadows, off-white lit surfaces, painterly medieval sprite. All walls/door/supports/platform, framing and exact building position unchanged. No chimney, people, objects, letters or background. Genuine transparent RGBA background. One asset.
assets.postprocess: Mechanical registration, snow color segmentation or loading door crop, clipped to unchanged base alpha and zeroed contact stripe. No procedural drawing.
assets.finalMeasurement: roof>=128 and snow mask>=128 and final overlay>=128; same previous-wave criterion
